channel.title: Reference :: Go Kure
channel.description: Look a package, a name or a setting up. API Reference - Every published package, grouped by purpose Kinds and Field Maturity - Which Kubernetes kinds and fields the builders cover Compatibility Matrix - Supported versions of Flux and the other dependencies Package Status - What is supported, limited, consumer-provided, not implemented or only proposed Builder Contract - What a constructor sets, when a helper exists, how to read the maturity table Go package documentation - The exported API on pkg.go.dev
